fact: Review determines whether the current candidate is ready for delivery.

Reviewers assess the candidate against the taskbook goals, delivery requirements, recorded user answers, and applicable project conventions. They use current candidate evidence and review the draft facts from Design and Implement.
Review can read the latest verification and paginated command receipts for the current candidate.

The review result tool checks the current turn’s candidate or diff receipts and its Draft Fact decisions before accepting a report. A missing receipt or decision returns correction instructions to the same reviewer.
